The '''Anti-Prophet''' was a malevolent entity in the religious cosmology of the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugors]]. [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] were considered to be the Anti-Prophet's pseudopodia, deserving of death or sacrifice to the [[Angel of Taxations and Imports]].<ref name="Scavenger Hunt" />
